erin: FYI saw a small uptick (~0.35%) in JSON schema rejects on tool-invoke for aurora-mid-q5 after the latest quant + debug instrumentation. spike at 02:45 UTC, dash: https://dash.internal/runs/5023
samir: any samples? is it truncation or stray bytes?
jo: grabbed a failed stream. looks like a debug marker `<|DBG|>` was emitted by the kernel and got split across stream chunks: `... ]<|DBG` then next chunk `|>\n` -> parser fails.
erin: repro: stream=true + kv-cache + ~750 token context. ci-bot repro attached:
ci-bot: ```bash
curl -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" -d '{"model":"aurora-mid-q5","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long..."}],"tools":[{"id":"write_record","schema":{}}]}'
```
samir: two issues: (1) kernel debug markers should never make it into prod streams, (2) streaming chunking can split markers mid-token. mitigation options: strip known markers in pre-parse middleware, and patch kernel to disable markers in prod builds.
jo: quick local fix: small sanitizer that removes `<|DBG|>` and any fragments like `<|DBG` or `DBG|>` across boundaries before schema validation. short python:
```
raw = raw.replace('<|DBG|>', '')
raw = re.sub(r'<\|DBG|>|<\|DBG', '', raw)
```
works for the canary samples but feels hacky.
ops: watch out: we saw retries on parse errors causing duplicate side-effects for two Dedicated tenants (they retried client-side after 400). ops recommends: change retry policy to not retry 4xx schema errors and require idempotency_key for side-effecting tool calls.
erin: plan: (1) infra: add pre-parse marker sanitizer behind ff and enable for aurora canary (samir) (2) kernel: disable marker emission in prod builds (jo) (3) platform: update retry policy to skip retries on 4xx parse errors and propose idempotency_key for tools (erin + ops) (4) eng-ml: add unit that simulates chunk-split marker at every offset (samir/jo)
ci-bot: created job: https://ci.internal/job/5023/marker-split-fuzz
samir: will open runtime PR and tests. jo: will open kernel PR to gate markers on debug builds. erin: i'll coordinate with product and notify affected canary tenants.
erin: thanks all, keeping this thread as the coordination point. ping @erin for trace access.
